# Check toc_tokens for M2 test
import markdown
from markdown.extensions.toc import striptags, run_postprocessors, render_inner_html

md = markdown.Markdown(extensions=['toc', 'footnotes'])
result = md.convert('# H[^1]\n\n[^1]: f')
print("toc_tokens:")
for tok in md.toc_tokens:
    print(f"  {tok}")
    
# Also verify that run_postprocessors and render_inner_html work
print("\nrun_postprocessors test:")
test_text = "Hello World"
pp_result = run_postprocessors(md, test_text)
print(f"  Input: {test_text!r}, Output: {pp_result!r}")

print("\nrender_inner_html test:")
from xml.etree import ElementTree as etree
root = etree.Element('div')
child = etree.SubElement(root, 'span')
child.text = 'inner content'
inner = render_inner_html(md, root)
print(f"  Result: {inner!r}")
